offset.$description: Distance of the corner button from the viewport's block-end and inline-end edges.

shift.$description: How far it slides in when it appears (none under reduced motion).

shadow.$description: Shadow of the corner button, so it reads above the page. The inline placement has none.

layer.$description: Stacking order of the corner button: the same level as the sticky header.

duration.$description: Duration of showing and hiding (0ms under reduced motion).
